qualityHelp.partial: CPU power is unavailable (WattScope is not running as Administrator on a machine that needs it). The GPU is still monitored. The system figure is a lower bound and no cost is shown.
qualityHelp.sensorUnavailable: No required sensor is available right now, so there is no estimate.
qualityHelp.stopped: Nothing is being recorded. Closing this window does not stop monitoring -- only Stop monitoring or Exit does.
qualityHelp.unavailable: The background monitor is not running. Choose Start monitoring to bring it back.

dashboard.costWithheld: Cost is not shown while the estimate is incomplete

gaming.title: Gaming
gaming.noGameHelp: A game is recognized while monitoring is running. Launchers, browsers and other programs are not counted as games.
gaming.needsMonitoring: Monitoring is stopped. Games are only detected while WattScope is monitoring.
gaming.partialBanner: Partial: CPU power is not available, so energy and system power are lower bounds and no complete cost is shown. GPU figures are still measured.

costStatus.withheldPartial: Not shown: the estimate is partial
costStatus.withheldUnpriced: Not shown: no electricity price covers this energy

source.userMapping: Marked as a game by you
source.libraryPath: Found in a game library folder

manual.help: Use this when a game is not detected automatically. The session uses the same monitoring and energy rules as an automatic one.
manual.name: Game name
manual.remember: Detect this program automatically next time

history.title: Gaming history
history.lowerBoundNote: This session is partial: values marked with ≥ are lower bounds, not complete estimates.
history.approxPrice: * Approximate: a price was added after this session was recorded, so its cost is split by time, not by measurement.

aggregates.title: Per game
aggregates.help: Complete and partial sessions are never added together. Averages are weighted by time, not averaged per session.

games.title: Manage games
games.help: Mark a program as a game, give it a name, or exclude it from detection. Your choices are stored on this computer only.
games.name: Game name
games.privacyNote: Detection only reads the list of running programs. WattScope never touches a game's memory or files and does not interact with the game.

reports.title: Reports
reports.approxNotice: Approximate: a price was added after this period was recorded and the raw samples needed to split it exactly are no longer available (past retention).
reports.replayedNotice: Exact: reconstructed by replaying raw samples recorded during this period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.retentionHelp: 15-minute energy totals and cost history are kept indefinitely regardless of this setting; only the raw per-sample readings are pruned.
settings.assumption: Assumption you set -- not a measurement
settings.invalidEfficiency: PSU efficiency must be between 1% and 100%.
settings.invalidInterval: Interval must be at least 250 ms.

background.title: Background monitoring
background.description: Closing this window keeps WattScope running in the system tray and monitoring continues. WattScope only runs while you have launched it; it does not start with Windows.
background.exitHelp: Stops monitoring, saves the session and closes WattScope completely.

administrator.title: Administrator
administrator.description: On some machines CPU power can only be read when WattScope runs as Administrator. WattScope never elevates itself: for complete CPU monitoring, close it and launch it manually with Run as administrator.

settings.intervalHelp: Changing the interval continues the same session; a short gap is recorded and no energy is invented across it.
